title.en: An Act Establishing a National High School in the Municipality of Ragay, Province of Camarines Sur, to Be Known as the Tomas Avila Andaya, Sr. National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a National High School in the Municipality of Ragay, Province of Camarines Sur, to Be Known as the Tomas Avila Andaya, Sr. National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia tại Thị trấn Ragay, Tỉnh Camarines Sur được biết đến với tên gọi Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia Tomas Avila Andaya, Sr.
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติในเทศบาล Ragay, จังหวัด Camarines Sur ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Tomas Avila Andaya, Sr.
title.id: Undang-Undang mendirikan Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional di Kotamadya Ragay, Provinsi Camarines Sur dikenal sebagai Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional Tomas Avila Andaya, Sr.
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan di Perbandaran Ragay, Wilayah Camarines Sur dikenali sebagai Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Tomas Avila Andaya, Sr.

text.en: There shall be established a high school in the Municipality of Ragay, Province of Camarines Sur, to be known as the Tomas Avila Andaya, Sr. National High School.
the Secretary of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
the amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
